## Description

Briefly describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement / refactor
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / CI update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to PSR-12 and strict typing (`declare(strict_types=1);`).
- [ ] I have executed the test suite locally (`vendor/bin/pest` or `composer test`) and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated documentation or README accordingly if needed.
- [ ] My changes do not introduce new unnecessary dependencies.
